C1251.title: Five Staten Island Residents Used Stolen Account Data to Obtain Apple Gift Cards in Million-Dollar Scheme
C1251.summary: Between July and September 2021, five defendants used information stolen from American Express cardholders to obtain legitimate Apple gift cards, then purchased products at Apple stores to liquidate the value.
